tldr: Lilith in the 9th house: the wild truth and the refusal of inherited belief
body: Lilith in the 9th house: the wild truth and the refusal of inherited belief. Where you reclaim your own meaning. Watch: dogmatic rebellion. You refuse imposed belief; raw truth-seeking that will not accept a borrowed worldview. Rejects imposed belief and conventional study in favor of instinctive knowing. Periodic, sweeping rethinks of worldview and values are part of the pattern.
shadow: Zealotry, or rejecting all meaning to stay free.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
